name_note: Most genomes GTDB places in g__Hominimerdicola are deposited in NCBI under Ruminococcus, and a taxonomic study lists the 'Ruminococcus bicirculans' type strain 80/3 as Hominimerdicola aceti.

sentences.text: Hominimerdicola intestinalis was proposed for a strain isolated from faecal samples of healthy Japanese volunteers.

The genome of Ruminococcus bicirculans, sequenced from a member of the human colonic microbiota, comprises two large chromosomes, and growth on hemicelluloses such as beta-glucans and xyloglucan was confirmed experimentally.
The same report describes this species as lacking the machinery for degrading cellulose and xylan that related cellulolytic ruminococci possess.

A study of schizophrenia reported Ruminococcus bicirculans among species depleted in the gut microbiota of patients, and an analysis of colorectal cancer reported subclades of this species associated with late-stage disease.
